summary: Rebuilds the fleet panel as a single page on native DjangoLux tables, filters, and dynamic modals, and copies the configured public HTTPS control-panel URL for pairing.
highlights: The fleet is one page: a native DjangoLux data table with filtering, paging, and resizable columns.
Right-click a project for every action — view, edit, update, backup, restart, enrolment, rotate, revoke, recovery.
All project detail and forms open as dynamic modals; the separate detail and form pages are gone.
An in-flight strip keeps queued operations visible across the fleet after their modal closes.
The pairing URL comes from the canonical BASE_URL instead of the internal post-TLS request scheme.
